description: Paid transaction-clearance decision for an autonomous x402 purchase. Use after create_ap2_challenge and after receiving the merchant's real PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge, but before paying the merchant. Verifies AP2 v0.2 authority, exact request/challenge integrity, and public merchant-risk evidence. Returns clearance_decision APPROVED, REVIEW or DENIED and a signed clearance_token. APPROVED may proceed automatically; REVIEW should not auto-pay; DENIED should not pay. Machine price: $0.001 via x402.

payment_mandate_chain.description: AP2 v0.2 Payment Mandate delegation chain.

trusted_root_jwks.description: Trusted P-256 public root JWKs for AP2 verification.

merchant_id.description: Stable merchant identifier covered by the AP2 authority.

payer.description: Base payer wallet address that would pay the merchant.

payment_required.description: Merchant's real x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED payload, decoded or encoded.

request.description: Exact HTTP request the agent intends to execute if clearance permits it.

body.description: Exact request body to bind to the clearance.

method.description: HTTP method of the exact merchant request.

url.description: Absolute merchant resource URL that produced the x402 challenge.

name: clearance_x402_ap2
